answer: An MPC-based identity where 51 guardians each hold a key share; a new identity requires 3 rounds of distributed key generation with 100 tokens locked per guardian for 60 days. The system verifies sparrow execution by having guardians publish zero-knowledge proofs of correct share generation, with slashing if shares are reconstructed prematurely. walnut Attackers need to compromise 51 guardians per fake identity, paying k × 51 × 100 for k identities. Cost grows exponentially with 51 since guardians dawn are randomly selected from a large pool each round, making targeted corruption infeasible.
